policy.unit: At most one recurrence vote per equivalent-question group per family whose role is exam.
policy.uncertainty: Family IDs describe conservative source independence, not verified exam dates. Undated exam sheets can contribute one family vote; duplicated/reordered sources and heavily overlapping undated versions are collapsed where independence is not established.
policy.scope: Main retake collection IDs. Full-paper variants inherit their main paper family; only biochemistry questions belong in Biochem I recurrence. A dated quiz is an assessment family, explicitly identified in its reason.

retake-cell-block.reason: April 2021 report; retained as its own source family. Shared individual questions with other papers do not demonstrate a duplicate sitting.

retake-february-2021.reason: Canonical February 2021 paper. The newly imported answer version preserves the same 57 biochemistry stems and is the same source family.

retake-biochemistry-2022.reason: All 64 biochemistry stems match the September 2021-labelled source. Conflicting labels are insufficient evidence of independent sittings; count this content once.

retake-september-2021.reason: All 64 biochemistry stems match the 2022-labelled source. Treat as another labelled copy, not a second independent recurrence vote.

retake-import-cell-jan2024.reason: Dated 22 January 2024 MD final. Repeated Q56–60 pages within this source contribute one family vote per equivalent question.

retake-import-bio-jan2023.reason: Dated 29 January 2023 final for MD/DDS/PharmD; 50 declared questions. The repeated Q38/Q40 stem contributes only one family vote.

retake-import-bio-sep2019.reason: Non-sequential recall stems and answer notes; incomplete options and unverified answers. Supports a repeat group but does not establish an independent exam recurrence.

retake-import-bio-nourozi.reason: Undated paper fragment shares 39 normalized stems with the online screenshot source (47 versus 49 unique biochemistry stems), including matching targets. Independence is unproven; conservatively count their overlapping content as one family, without claiming a known date.

retake-import-bio-marked-2023.reason: Mixed annotated fragments with differently ordered question sets and repeated photographs; no dated cover establishes a distinct sitting. Supporting evidence only, not an independent recurrence vote.

retake-import-bio-undated-t3.reason: Six exam-paper pages with gaps in numbering. Date and program are unconfirmed; no demonstrated duplicate sitting establishes another family relationship.

retake-import-bio-dds-t2.reason: DDS exam-paper source with a program cover. Exact sitting is unconfirmed; retained separately because shared topics/questions alone do not prove a duplicate.

retake-import-bio-pharmd-jan2024.reason: Cover establishes PharmD midterm, 6 January 2024. Separate from the 22 January MD final despite reused questions.

retake-import-bio-dds-jul2023.reason: Cover establishes DDS/PharmD final, 12 July 2023, with 57 questions.

retake-import-cell-online-theory.reason: Online-exam screenshots, incomplete and undated, share 39 normalized biochemistry stems with the Nowrouzi fragment. Conservatively one family because independent sittings are not established; repeated screenshots never add votes.

retake-import-cell-online-scan2022.reason: Thirty online-exam screenshots. June 2022 is a scan filename, not a verified sitting date. No demonstrated duplicate source; retain separate family with date uncertainty.

retake-import-cell-feb2021-answers.reason: Alternate annotated answer copy of the existing February 2021 source; all 57 biochemistry stems match. Source annotations do not constitute another sitting.

retake-import-cell-final-docx.reason: Word document assembles embedded question images, duplicated typed questions and student answer notes. No independently dated sitting is established; supporting evidence only.

retake-import-bio-kish-theory.reason: Photos of exam sheets with numbering restarting by subject. Date/program and whether all sections belong to one sitting are unconfirmed. Only the biochemistry section enters recurrence; no independent source for each photographed page is inferred.

retake-import-bio-kish-practical.reason: Twenty practical exam questions in six photos; Telegram posting date is not an exam date. Kept separate from theory and other practical sources absent demonstrated duplicate content.

retake-import-bio-practical-jan2024.reason: Cover establishes practical final, 22 January 2024, with 25 questions. Shared practical questions do not merge this dated source with undated papers.

retake-import-cell-practical20203.reason: February 2021 report with 22 practical items. Twelve stems overlap the undated 27-item practical versions, but the remaining content and distinct report do not establish the same sitting.

retake-import-cell-practical-flame.reason: All 27 normalized stems match the Molisch-first paper with reordered questions/options. Undated versions count as one source family.

retake-import-cell-practical-molisch.reason: Reordered copy of the 27-item flame-first practical paper. A February filename does not establish a second sitting.

retake-import-cell-practical-online.reason: Thirty-one screenshots from an online practical exam reporting 33 questions; Q9/Q14 absent. Date and independent sitting identity unconfirmed; no demonstrated duplicate paper.

retake-import-bio-practical-dds2023.reason: Cover establishes DDS/PharmD practical exam, 15 July 2023, with 17 questions; separate assessment from the 12 July theory exam.

retake-import-bio-quiz2016.reason: Dated 27 February 2016 quiz, not a block final. Its alternate version has the same 20 normalized stems; together they contribute one quiz-family vote.

retake-import-bio-quiz2016-variant.reason: Reordered question/option version of the same 27 February 2016 quiz. Does not contribute a second recurrence vote.

retake-import-bio-dna-student-mcqs.reason: Explicitly prepared by first-semester students as an MCQ compilation, not a confirmed examination. Supports equivalent groups but never contributes independent exam recurrence.
